title: Supposititious
summary: SUPPOSITI'TIOUS, adjective [Latin supposititius, from suppositus, suppono.] Put by trick in the place or character belonging to another; not genuine; as a supposititious child; a supposititious writin

inlines.v: SUPPOSITI'TIOUS, adjective [Latin supposititius, from suppositus, suppono.] Put by trick in the place or character belonging to another; not genuine; as a supposititious child; a supposititious writing.
